dom.workbench: Keep .review-workbench grid, .review-task-list aside and .review-detail main classes to provide one stable layout seam. Aside contains #task-list-mount exclusively owned by generation-view; delete #review-list-mount and old review-card list.
dom.single_detail: Main contains existing #compare-panel, existing #rework-panel, plus #shot-execution for generation-view's selected-shot execution/Unknown/reconcile/diagnostics only, and nearby error mount. No duplicate full-shot cards.
dom.batch: Existing #attempt-editor remains the global batch/status/queue root, not a second task list. Prompt advanced details and actual sending summary remain reachable in make; ordinary default actions do not require advanced prompt editing.
dom.narrow: At <=900px use labeled native single-shot selector instead of stacked full task cards; same selection/detail state. Preserve explicit batch checkboxes/range while changing viewed shot.
dom.scope_controls: Use #make-mode-single and #make-mode-batch for explicit mode; input[data-batch-shot] value=shotId for batch range; #make-shot-select for narrow viewed-shot selection; [data-view-shot] value=shotId (or data attribute containing exact id) for desktop task selection. #generation-scope-count reports actual chosen count. These are UI seams for current real consumer walkthroughs, not alternate submission APIs.

view_contract.compare: CompareView continues openCompare(shotId, options), isComparing(shotId), renderCompare() but supports planned ungenerated shots with honest empty detail. Add currentShotId(): string|null and hasUnsavedDrafts(): boolean. Add required deps.onViewedShotChanged(shotId) signal only when actual viewed shot changes, including first stable choice; workspace wires to GenerationView.onViewedShotChanged(shotId). Delete renderReviewList(), reviewList element and old duplicate card machinery; delete public renderSelectionProgress() if obsolete and migrate callers. Adoption progress/status/error live in detail, not another list. On first valid plan choose a stable first viewed shot; later result arrivals never choose a different viewed shot/candidate.
view_contract.generation: GenerationView is the unique task-list owner. Add taskList and shotExecution elements and onViewedShotChanged(shotId). Use deps.viewedShotId() and existing deps.openCompare() for selection. Remove old renderSelectionProgress callback. Task row shows one thumbnail, human label/purpose and only current high-priority execution/selection state; single/multi scope explicitly independent of viewed item. No old full attempt cards for every shot.
view_contract.scope: Default single-image sending scope tracks the explicitly viewed shot, not all planned images. Explicit batch mode shows checkboxes and counts. Add only a narrow owner command setInitialScope(shotIds: readonly string[]) to set initial chosen shot ids; actual initial eligible queue intersection and prepare/confirm/revalidate/reserve/submit stay in generation owner. Keep failed_retry and explicit_new semantics unchanged; routine rerenders must not reset their mode. Only explicit viewed-shot changes in single mode or explicit range/mode changes choose a new initial scope. Empty chosen range never falls back to all. Summary must show chosen/blocked/excluded truth and current count; no POST from mode/range changes.
view_contract.refresh: Workspace beforeunload protection combines actual unsaved compare drafts with existing genuinely dirty prompt/fact drafts. Never compare old DOM against newly persisted system text. Project switch and close preserve current explicit confirmation behavior. Keyboard selection must not nest interactive controls inside another button.
view_contract.coordination: Workspace owner wires the specified API. If a seam needs change, message the other owner and parent before using a different signature; only the assigned owner edits a shared file.

compare_behavior: Default left is product reference, right is exactly the viewed candidate. History changes left only and does not replace right, adopted image, problem candidate or actual model input. Do not reserve a permanently empty third image column.

Adjacent rework modifies the fixed candidate reference and has explicit edit_candidate(default) versus regenerate_original choice, truthful source/order and manual-wholetext choice. Do not derive source from selected adoption, latest candidate, history baseline or candidate id alone.

Draft key includes project, shot, exact candidate version/hash and mode. Explicit restore selector identifies the owning candidate/mode. Typed problems/direction retain insertion point, focus and values while late results/report updates rerender. Cancellation returns to original visible trigger without stealing later focus.
No fresh model calls, storage migrations or new persistence abstraction. Use existing compare/selection/generation owners and plain private view state.
